title: Which of a lake-stocking society's lakes go into its 2027 high-use catchable tier on 2026 open-water angler-hours per hectare, the creel survey's route-timed flight counts read against each lake's own hour-by-hour presence from the access interviews
subdomain: sample-design-allocation-weighting (a lake-stocking society's creel survey: each lake's open-water angler-hours per hectare from aerial counts flown at route-fixed hours and the access interviews' start and finish times)
prompt_shape: a tier for every lake that takes catchables against the allocation policy's high-use line with a bar chart, and two per-lake tables (the catchables each lake received alive in 2026; the July and August warm days at each lake's 1 m logger)
